question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word in the following sentence to fill in the blank.

The medical procedure was successful, but the patient experienced some minor ________(troubles) during recovery.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "complications".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"troubles"** means problems or difficulties that cause distress or inconvenience. (समस्याएं)

 
 
• **Example: **She faced several troubles while trying to get her visa approved.
 
 
 
• **"Complications"** refers to difficulties that arise unexpectedly, often making a situation harder to deal with. (जटिलताएं)
 
 
• **Example: **The surgery was successful, but the patient experienced some complications during recovery.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. "complications".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Applications** (आवेदन): The act of putting something to a special use or purpose.

 
 
• **Example:** The applications for the scholarship are due next week.
 
 
 
• **Transformations** (परिवर्तन): A thorough or dramatic change in form or appearance.
 
 
• **Example:** The transformation of the city over the last decade has been remarkable.
 
 
 
• **Obligations** (कर्तव्य): A duty or commitment.
 
 
• **Example:** He has family obligations that he needs to fulfill.
